name: community_listening_engine
description: A conversation-to-client system designed to book, guide, and capture workflow conversations with business owners.

scripts.build: wrangler deploy --dry-run --config wrangler.toml && wrangler deploy --dry-run --config wrangler.transcription.toml
scripts.test: TS_NODE_FILES=true node --loader ts-node/esm tests/worker.test.ts && TS_NODE_FILES=true node --loader ts-node/esm tests/queue-transcription.test.ts && node tests/pages-functions.test.js
scripts.deploy:cloudflare: npm run deploy:webhook && npm run deploy:transcription
